title: Institution and small-business resource records
summary: Colleges, canteens, and offices should log electricity, water, travel, and waste per location and period. Demonstration workspaces are labelled. Real organisational data needs access control before any public hosting.
content:
Use a separate workspace for an organisation. Assign a reporting period that matches bills (usually monthly). Keep estimated kitchen waste distinct from metered electricity.

This student prototype scopes data by workspace id. It is not a full role-based production IAM system. Do not load confidential staff or student personal data.
applicability_conditions: Tracks more than a single household
implementation_steps: Create or select the demonstration business workspace
Enter location-level bills as measured records
Export CSV/PDF for mentors without mixing household data
limitations: Memberships and fine-grained roles are a thin model in this MVP
